nights.title: The Dresden Dolls
nights.name: The Dresden Dolls
nights.extract: The Dresden Dolls is an American musical duo from Boston, Massachusetts. Formed in 2000, the group consists of Amanda Palmer and Brian Viglione. The two describe their style as "Brechtian punk cabaret", a phrase invented by Palmer because she was "terrified" that the press would invent a name that "would involve the word gothic". The Dresden Dolls aesthetic exemplifies dark cabaret.

en.who: The Dresden Dolls is an American musical duo from Boston, Massachusetts. Formed in 2000, the group consists of Amanda Palmer and Brian Viglione.
facts: The two describe their style as "Brechtian punk cabaret", a phrase invented by Palmer because she was "terrified" that the press would invent a name that "would involve the word gothic".
The Dresden Dolls aesthetic exemplifies dark cabaret.

de.who: The Dresden Dolls ist ein amerikanisches Musikduo aus Boston, Massachusetts. Die 2000 gegründete Gruppe besteht aus Amanda Palmer und Brian Viglione.
facts: Die beiden nennen ihren Stil „Brechtian punk cabaret“, einen Begriff, den Palmer erfand, weil sie befürchtete, die Presse würde einen Namen mit dem Wort gothic erfinden.
Ihre Ästhetik steht exemplarisch für den dunklen Kabarett-Stil.

tr.who: The Dresden Dolls, Boston, Massachusetts'ten gelen Amerikalı bir müzik ikilisidir. 2000 yılında kurulan grup Amanda Palmer ve Brian Viglione'dan oluşur.
facts: Grup tarzını "Brechtian punk cabaret" diye tanımlıyor; bu ifadeyi Palmer, basının "gothic" kelimesini içeren bir isim uydurmasından korktuğu için bulmuş.
Dresden Dolls'un estetiği karanlık kabareyi örnekliyor.

nights.title: Jacques Greene
nights.name: Jacques Greene
nights.extract: Philippe Aubin-Dionne, better known by the stage name Jacques Greene, is a Canadian electronic musician based in Toronto. He has released music on the LuckyMe and Night Slugs labels and co-owns Vase Records.

facts: Er hat Musik auf den Labels LuckyMe und Night Slugs veröffentlicht.
Außerdem ist er Mitinhaber von Vase Records.

facts: LuckyMe ve Night Slugs plaklarında müzik yayımlamıştır.

nights.title: SWEEPING PROMISES
nights.name: Sweeping Promises
nights.extract: Sweeping Promises is an American post-punk duo from Boston, Massachusetts, now based in Lawrence, Kansas, consisting of Lira Mondal and Caufield Schnug. Multi-instrumentalist Spenser Gralla has toured as their live drummer since 2019.

en.who: Sweeping Promises is an American post-punk duo from Boston, Massachusetts, now based in Lawrence, Kansas. The duo consists of Lira Mondal and Caufield Schnug.
facts: Multi-instrumentalist Spenser Gralla has toured as their live drummer since 2019.
The duo is now based in Lawrence, Kansas.

facts: Çok çalgılı müzisyen Spenser Gralla, 2019'dan beri canlı performanslarda onların davulcusu olarak tur yapıyor.

nights.title: MICO
nights.name: Mico
nights.extract: Jose Miguel Veloso, known professionally as Mico, is a Canadian singer-songwriter and musician from Toronto. He initially grew a fanbase online through Discord and Twitch, breaking out commercially with his 2022 single "cut my hair", which became a top-30 radio hit in Canada. In 2025, he signed with Columbia Records following a string of independent extended plays.

en.who: Jose Miguel Veloso, known professionally as Mico, is a Canadian singer-songwriter and musician from Toronto. He began building a fanbase online through Discord and Twitch.
facts: He initially grew a fanbase online through Discord and Twitch, breaking out commercially with his 2022 single "cut my hair", which became a top-30 radio hit in Canada.
In 2025, he signed with Columbia Records following a string of independent extended plays.

de.who: Jose Miguel Veloso, künstlerisch bekannt als Mico, ist ein kanadischer Singer-Songwriter und Musiker aus Toronto. Er baute zunächst online über Discord und Twitch eine Fangemeinde auf.
facts: Den kommerziellen Durchbruch schaffte er mit seiner Single "cut my hair" aus dem Jahr 2022, die in Kanada zu einem Top-30-Radiohit wurde.
Im Jahr 2025 unterschrieb er bei Columbia Records, nachdem er eine Reihe unabhängiger Extended Plays veröffentlicht hatte.

tr.who: Sahne adı Mico olan Jose Miguel Veloso, Toronto'dan Kanadalı bir şarkıcı, söz yazarı ve müzisyendir. Önce Discord ve Twitch üzerinden çevrim içi bir hayran kitlesi oluşturdu.
facts: 2022 yılında çıkardığı "cut my hair" single'ı ile ticari anlamda çıkış yaptı; şarkı Kanada'da radyo listelerinde ilk 30'a girdi.
2025 yılında bağımsız EP'lerinin ardından Columbia Records ile sözleşme imzaladı.

nights.title: Owen Riegling
nights.name: Owen Riegling
nights.extract: Owen Michael Riegling is a Canadian country music singer and songwriter. He is currently signed to Universal Music Canada and Big Loud Records. He has charted multiple singles including "Old Dirt Roads", "Moonshines", "Taillight This Town", and "Love Hate Love". He released his debut album Bruce County  in 2024. His second album In the Feeling was released in April 2026.

tr.who: Owen Michael Riegling, Kanadalı bir country müzik şarkıcısı ve söz yazarıdır. Şu anda Universal Music Canada ve Big Loud Records ile sözleşmelidir.
facts: "Old Dirt Roads", "Moonshines", "Taillight This Town" ve "Love Hate Love" gibi birden fazla single listelere girdi.

nights.title: Olafur Arnalds
nights.name: Ólafur Arnalds
nights.extract: Ólafur Arnalds is an Icelandic multi-instrumentalist and producer from Mosfellsbær, Iceland. He mixes strings and piano with loops and beats, a sound ranging from ambient/electronic to atmospheric pop. He is also the former drummer for hardcore punk and metal bands Fighting Shit, Celestine, and others.

Er war außerdem Schlagzeuger der Hardcore-Punk- und Metal-Bands Fighting Shit, Celestine und weiterer Bands.

facts: Yaylı çalgıları ve piyanoyu döngüler ve beat'lerle birleştirir; sesi ambient ve elektronikten atmosferik popa uzanır.
Hardcore punk ve metal gruplarında, Fighting Shit, Celestine ve diğerlerinde davulcu olarak da çalmıştır.

nights.title: Clara La San - Chosen Silences Tour 2026
nights.name: Clara La San
nights.extract: Rosemary Clare Louise Francis, known professionally as Clara La San, is a British singer, songwriter, and record producer. In 2013, her debut song "Let You Go" became popular on SoundCloud. Her follow-up song "In This Darkness" later went viral on TikTok upon being rereleased in 2022. Her debut studio album, Made Mistakes, was released in 2024.

nights.title: Sullivan King
nights.name: Sullivan King
nights.extract: Keaton Prescott, known artistically as Sullivan King, is an American DJ of dubstep music and heavy metal musician. He has drawn attention from the music press for his unusual blending of EDM and electric guitar-centered heavy metal performance, "making his live shows one of the few places where kandi-coated ravers and metalheads mingle". King has made multiple US tours since his concert debut in 2014, most recently announcing a nationwide tour during the latter half of 2021, and has released singles collaborating with musicians including Papa Roach and drummer Matt McGuire of The Chainsmokers.

en.kicker: american dubstep dj and heavy metal musician

King hat Singles mit Musikern wie Papa Roach und dem Schlagzeuger Matt McGuire von The Chainsmokers veröffentlicht.

nights.title: PSYCROPTIC
nights.name: Psycroptic
nights.extract: Psycroptic are an Australian technical death metal band formed in Hobart, Tasmania in 1999. The Haley brothers, drummer Dave and guitarist Joe, are mainstay members. Singer Jason Peppiatt joined in 2004. In 2008, they signed to Nuclear Blast. As of August 2022, the band have released eight studio albums. They have toured Australia supporting Incantation, Decapitated, Origin and Misery Index. Psycroptic have toured Europe with Nile and Deicide. In February 2019, the band co-headlined a tour with Aversions Crown and support bands Within Destruction, Hadal Maw and Hollow World across Europe. They headlined a 2019 tour of the United States in support of the album As the Kingdom Drowns.

nights.title: Geoff Tate - Operation: Mindcrime - The Final Chapter
nights.name: Geoff Tate
nights.extract: Geoff Tate is an American singer. He rose to fame with the progressive metal band Queensrÿche, who had commercial success with their 1988 album Operation: Mindcrime and 1990 album Empire. Tate is ranked fourteenth on Hit Parader's list of the 100 Greatest Metal Vocalists of All Time. He was voted No. 2 on That Metal Show's top 5 hard rock vocalists of the 1980s. In 2012, he won the Vegas Rocks! Magazine Music Award for "Voice in Progressive Heavy Metal". In 2015, he placed ninth on OC Weekly's list of the 10 Best High-Pitched Metal Singers. After his farewell tour as Queensrÿche, he renamed his band Operation: Mindcrime, after the Queensrÿche album of the same name.

en.who: Geoff Tate is an American singer. He is ranked fourteenth on Hit Parader's list of the 100 Greatest Metal Vocalists of All Time.
facts: He rose to fame with the progressive metal band Queensrÿche, who had commercial success with their 1988 album Operation: Mindcrime and 1990 album Empire.
After his farewell tour as Queensrÿche, he renamed his band Operation: Mindcrime, after the Queensrÿche album of the same name.

de.who: Geoff Tate ist ein amerikanischer Sänger. Auf der Liste der 100 größten Metal-Sänger aller Zeiten von Hit Parader belegt er Platz 14.
facts: Er wurde mit der Progressive-Metal-Band Queensrÿche bekannt, die mit ihren Alben Operation: Mindcrime (1988) und Empire (1990) kommerziell erfolgreich war.
Nach seiner Abschiedstournee mit Queensrÿche benannte er seine Band in Operation: Mindcrime um, nach dem gleichnamigen Album von Queensrÿche.

tr.who: Geoff Tate, Amerikalı bir şarkıcıdır. Hit Parader'ın tüm zamanların en iyi 100 metal vokalisti listesinde on dördüncü sıradadır.

Queensrÿche ile veda turnesinin ardından grubunu, Queensrÿche'ın aynı adlı albümünden esinlenerek Operation: Mindcrime olarak yeniden adlandırdı.

nights.title: PROTOMARTYR
nights.name: Protomartyr
nights.extract: Protomartyr is an American post-punk band formed in Detroit, Michigan, in 2010. The band consists of Joe Casey (vocals), Greg Ahee (guitar), Alex Leonard (drums), and Scott Davidson (bass). During live performances, the band is currently joined by multi-instrumentalist Fred Thomas. Between 2020 and 2024, Kelley Deal joined the band in a touring capacity, providing additional keyboards, guitar and backing vocals.

nights.title: FOG LAKE
nights.name: Fog Lake
nights.extract: Aaron Powell, known professionally as Fog Lake, is a Canadian singer-songwriter. Powell began writing and recording songs in his hometown of Glovertown, Newfoundland. In 2014, he moved from cassette label Birdtapes to become part of the New York City-based label Orchid Tapes. Powell's recordings have been described as "a complex collage of nebulous angst and heartfelt nostalgia".
